_comment: Toolchain SSOT. flake.nix installs these; bin/check-tools verifies a non-Nix machine.
`required` means the gate fails without it. A tool flips to required when the stage
that needs it lands — see doc/roadmap.md. Keep this file and flake.nix in step.

java.why: Clojure host (22+ for the FFM/wasmtime path in S1)

node.why: S0: the V8 lane (WasmGC + speculative inlining)

wasmtime.why: S0: the server lane. WASI 0.3 needs 43+, default-on at 46
